prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game sprite atlas for Rockman.EXE / MegaMan.EXE matching provided motion sheet. Preserve reference design exactly: young boy-like NetNavi, green eyes and friendly determined face visible in navy helmet, vivid cobalt blue armor, central yellow helmet rectangles and yellow-green trim, orange circular ear units with red/navy cores, yellow neck/shoulder details, black/navy under-suit, chest circular orange-red insignia, large blue boots and blue gloves. Match compact youthful proportions and reference silhouette, not adult muscular anatomy, not Mega Man X or Zero. Clean premium anime cel illustration, crisp outlines, refined shading.
Exactly 6 columns x4 rows of24 isolated WHOLE-BODY sprites in1536x1024, equal cells, ample transparent gutters. SAME body/helmet dimensions across cells. Entire boots and weapons unclipped. All actions facing RIGHT except explicit backward attack. No captions, numbers, grid, opponents, floor, backgrounds or baked-in trails/impacts. Actual transparent alpha.
ROW1:0 neutral combat standing three-quarter RIGHT with two normal gloves;1 walking step;2 leaning forward run;3 low crouch;4 rising jump knees bent;5 descending arms spread.
ROW2:6 aiming blue arm buster straight RIGHT, small red muzzle core, no shot;7 second buster firing stance recoiled;8 upward buster uppercut;9 green energy sword wide slash RIGHT from transformed arm;10 midair buster aiming RIGHT;11 low crouching rolling kick RIGHT.
ROW3:12 very wide green energy sword thrust RIGHT;13 lifting arm to summon upward digital panels (do not draw panels);14 BACKWARD green sword slash toward LEFT while body oriented right;15 overhead circular green sword sweep;16 downward green sword plunge;17 reach with normal gloved hand to grab RIGHT.
ROW4:18 elbow pummel RIGHT;19 buster aimed pointblank RIGHT;20 guarding;21 recoiling from hit;22 lying defeated on side;23 confident victory fist raised.
Base gloves turn into a single arm cannon for shooting poses and into arm sword for sword poses. Every figure complete and consistent reference design, no giant effects or decoration outside character. Transparent PNG.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production second transparent sprite atlas for Rockman.EXE / MegaMan.EXE. Reference1 is original motion sheet, reference2 approved first game poses. EXACT same youthful compact proportions, head/helmet size, face, GREEN EYES, vivid cobalt armor, navy undersuit, yellow neck armor and helmet details, orange ear discs, red chest insignia and large blue boots. Do not redesign, no adult anatomy.
EXACT6 columns x4 rows =24 isolated complete full-body sprites in1536x1024 with equal transparent cells and generous gutters. All face RIGHT. Keep same helmet/body dimensions across EVERY pose. No captions, labels, grid, backgrounds, floor, effects, opponent, arrows or trails. True transparent alpha. Character fully inside each cell including boots/hand.
ROW1:24 walk left leg forward;25 walk passing step;26 walk right leg forward;27 walk opposite passing step;28 run extended stride;29 run passing stride.
ROW2:30 run opposite extended stride;31 run next passing stride;32 jump squat;33 ascending jump;34 second jump tucked knees;35 falling feet below.
ROW3:36 landing crouch;37 standing up from lying;38 ledge hang grasping invisible RIGHT ledge with BOTH normal gloves held high above head and legs below;39 climb invisible RIGHT ledge;40 charging buster arm extended RIGHT (no aura);41 forward reaching pose to activate digital area-steal (no panels).
ROW4:42 compressed preparatory pose both boots on invisible reflection pad;43 arcing jump soaring diagonally upward RIGHT, body curled;44 recovery descending upright arms spread;45 activating style change, upright hand at chest emblem;46 taunt holding one small glowing blue rectangular chip;47 confident victory looking toward right with fist on hip.
Match first approved sprite designs and polished anime cel shading. Preserve original pose dimensions and costume. No painted light or geometry outside character except the small held chip. Transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG VFX and portrait atlas for Rockman.EXE/MegaMan.EXE matching reference. EXACT3 columns x4 rows =12 isolated items in1536x2048 portrait canvas, equal cells generous gutters. Every item entirely within its cell, no labels, no borders, no scenery or floor. Actual transparent alpha.
ROW1 cell0: cyan-white small horizontal buster energy bullet traveling RIGHT, bright center and blue taper tail on LEFT; cell1: vivid green-white charged spherical shot with green rings and short LEFT-facing tail; cell2: lime green white crescent energy sword arc sweeping toward RIGHT.
ROW2 cell3: vertical cyan digital rectangular panels with small blue square circuitry, area steal effect; cell4: a single horizontal oval reflective panel with orange top and cyan digital square base, viewed at angle; cell5: cyan holographic custom-style emblem made of small digital squares and vertical shimmering rays.
ROW3 cell6: red-orange holographic power-style emblem with fierce geometric flame rays; cell7: gold-yellow holographic shield-style emblem with hexagon and defensive layered rings; cell8: green holographic speed-style emblem with wing-like digital rays.
ROW4 cell9: blue-white horizontal boot boost trail tapering LEFT; cell10: bright yellow-white and cyan compact hit impact spark; cell11: excellent MegaMan.EXE HEAD AND SHOULDERS portrait three-quarter RIGHT with face readable, green eyes, youthful compact face, cobalt helmet, yellow central helmet rectangles/yellow-green trim, orange ear units, yellow neck armor, blue shoulder armor and red chest emblem. Original reference and approved sprites are design anchors. Match polished anime cel shading and crisp outlines. Do NOT include character figures in effect cells0to10, only final portraitcell11. No words/captions.
